seoTitle: Atlanta Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates and Downloads
seoDescription: Atlanta Public Schools 2026–27 calendar dates: first and last days of school, major breaks, early-release days, official PDF, and ICS download.
heroSummary: Atlanta Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 3, 2026. The last day of school is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break is October 14–16, Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, and Spring Break is April 5–9. APS has early-release days on September 21 and March 15. Students return from December Break on Tuesday, January 5; Monday, January 4 is a teacher professional learning day.
calendarNotes: The official APS 2026–27 student calendar lists 180 instructional days, with 88 days in the first semester and 92 days in the second semester. Students start on August 3, 2026 and finish on May 27, 2027. Early-release days are scheduled for September 21 and March 15. Teacher professional learning days are October 12–13, November 3, January 4, and February 15; students do not attend on those dates shown on the official calendar.
heroFactChips: 88 days in the first semester and 92 in the second
compareIntro: Compare APS with Cobb County, DeKalb County, and Fulton County Schools. The table focuses on the dates local families are most likely to compare.
comparisonSourceNote: Rows group comparable break periods; district names may differ. Adjacent holidays and staff workdays are not included unless they fall within the listed range.
keyDatesSummarySubtitle: First and last days of school, plus the district's major break dates
allDatesCoverageNote: This table covers dates from the first student day through the last student day. Staff-only dates and district holidays outside that period are not included.
verificationBadgeText: Last checked July 28, 2026 against the official APS student calendar.
icsDescription: Download the 2026–27 dates for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.

calendarFaqs.q: When is APS December Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: December Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Students return Tuesday, January 5, after a teacher professional learning day on January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is APS Winter Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: APS Winter Break runs from Tuesday, February 16, through Friday, February 19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the APS early-release days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: APS has two PreK-12 early-release days in 2026–27: Monday, September 21, 2026, and Monday, March 15, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the official APS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Atlanta Public Schools calendar page and the official APS student calendar PDF for final confirmation.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the APS school calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Download the MySchoolDates 2026–27 ICS file and import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. This is a one-time import and will not update automatically if APS revises its calendar.

customSections.label: What APS Families Need to Know
customSections.content: These are the APS 2026–27 dates most likely to affect pickup, childcare, and the first day back after a break.

groups.label: Attendance and dismissal changes
items: Students attend school but are dismissed earlier than usual on September 21 and March 15. Check your school's dismissal, bus, and after-school program schedule.
Students do not attend school on October 12–13, November 3, January 4, or February 15. These dates appear separately from the district's named school breaks.

groups.label: Break names and return dates
items: APS uses "December Break" for the late-December holiday period and "Winter Break" for its February break. Students begin the second semester on Tuesday, January 5.

groups.label: School-specific dates
items: This page covers districtwide student dates. Testing, athletics, graduation, performances, and other school events may follow separate schedules.

customSections.label: Changes from the 2025–26 Calendar
customSections.content: These are the main APS calendar changes families are most likely to notice when comparing 2026–27 with 2025–26.

rows: School starts August 3 instead of August 4
Transportation, childcare, and first-week routines need to be ready by August 3.
School ends May 27 instead of May 22
The later last day may affect the timing of summer travel and childcare.
APS adds a second PreK-12 early-release day
Pickup and after-school arrangements may need to change on September 21 and March 15.
Families may need childcare on January 4 because students do not attend.
